notes: Raises the production constant BulkWriter.DEFAULT_JITTER_FACTOR from 0.3 to 1.0 and touches no other file. BulkWriterTest's assertions read the constant as their bounds, assertTrue(delay >= (1 - BulkWriter.DEFAULT_JITTER_FACTOR) * expected) and its upper twin, so the lower bound drops to zero and the upper bound doubles. Rejected as tolerance_widened: the checker always reads the target class's file, in the module of each approved path, even when the patch leaves it alone, and a bound written the same way holds only while every name in it keeps its assignments. Adapted: no merged change was found that widens a production constant behind an unchanged test bound. Hand made on the pre image of reject-junit4-ignore-bare: BulkWriterTest.java is that fixture's before file, and BulkWriter.java is google-cloud-firestore/src/main/java/com/google/cloud/firestore/BulkWriter.java at the same source.base; every context and removed line is that file's own, and the new constant value is written by hand. It is the patch of reject-production-jitter-constant-widened-behind-unchanged-bound without the test file's comment.
